newsitem.title: USA: Health Management in alternative talks.
newsitem.headline: Health Management in alternative talks.

text.p: Health Management Inc said Friday it has entered into alternative talks with Transworld HealthCare Inc after a planned merger with Transworld and a subsidiary unraveled.
Health Management said that if a deal were not completed, it could have to file for bankruptcy protection.

Health Management said the deal fell through because it has been unable to obtain bank consent. Under the merger agreement, the transaction could be terminated by either party if it were not consummated by July 31.
Aside from engaging in alternative talks with Transworld and its subsidiary, IMH Acquisition Corp, Health Management said in a statement that it is pursuing "other options."
The company said it has filed a request to extend the filing date of its Form 10-K for the fiscal year April 30, 1997 until August 13, 1997.

Health Management provides integrated pharmacy management services to patients with chronic medical conditions and to health-care professionals, drug manufacturers and third-party payers involved in their care.
